title: Block-sparse attention selection
summary: Use block size 16 and two selected causal blocks per query head to inspect a local educational selector independently of any campaign.

steps.explanation: The selector identifies available causal blocks, chooses top-K blocks per head, then attends to their raw keys and values.
observe: first selected sparse positions in a full probe diagnostic

prerequisites: Prepare the selected tokenizer only for an initialized probe; prepare data before training.
try_changes: Predict the available versus selected context before probing.
Change only selected_blocks; full coverage approaches the dense reference.
Inspect batch/head union rather than treating a per-head K as a global work bound.
limits: The Python implementation is an educational selector, not a timing or sparse-kernel verdict.
Batch/head union can exceed an individual head's selection budget.
